description: Cells were treated for 72h with DMSO, vorinostat (3.7µM), sorafenib (0.65µM), and resveratrol (166µM).

SNU-387 (ATCC® CRL-2237™, grade IV/V) and HepG2/C3A (ATCC® CRL-10741™) were grown in a RPMI-1640 medium supplemented with 100U/ml penicillin, 100μg/ml streptomycin and 10% fetal bovine serum. Cultures were performed at 37°C in a 5% CO2 atmosphere.

The scanned images were analyzed with Feature Extraction Software 10.7.3.1 (Agilent Technologies) using default parameters (protocol GE1_107_Sep09_ssSurrogates and Grid: 028004_D_F_20101102). Gene expression data were further analyzed by using the GeneSpring software (Agilent Technologies). Features flagged in Feature Extraction as 'Feature not positive and significant' and 'Feature not above background' were excluded. Normalization was based on the 75th percentile shift.
Sequencing was performed with the Illumina HiSeq 2000 and basecalls analyzed using Illumina RTA 1.17.21.3.
Samples demultiplexed using Illumina Casava 1.8.2 using adapter masking.

Sequenced reads were trimmed for masked adapters and low quality extremities using Trimmomatic 0.35 and then mapped to the reference genome using STAR version 2.5.1b, guided by transcript annotations from Gencode version 26.
Readcounts were computed by STAR during sequence alignment based on annotations from Gencode 26

Supplementary_files_format_and_content: Readcounts: Tab-delimited file where columns are Ensembl gene identifier, counts for unstranded RNA, counts for 1st strand aligned, counts for 2nd strand aligned
